The '''Gymsnor series''' was a series of ambitious but unsuccessful freighters put out by [[CorelliSpace]] to compete with the [[YT-series/Legends|YT-series]] produced by [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] on civilian transport market.
